flagship_directive: Prove a simultaneous-arm indistinguishability lower bound matching the improved upper rate throughout the ratio-to-zero regime, including the exact fixed-K logarithms and an ordered version yielding the matching honest one-sided excess-length converse.
critique: The titular exact all-K frontier is not delivered: the note proves a two-sided but unmatched risk sandwich and exact root-N orders only when K/N^{q_d} is bounded below, while fixed-K logarithms, the multi-arm factor, and the small-ratio honest-length converse remain open. The improved plug-in upper rate is therefore only an achievability bound outside the proved root-N region, not a sharp minimax characterization there. Moreover, that upper theorem—and consequently the d=5 threshold q_5=1/6 and plug-in length result—depends on the unproved, uncited load-bearing lemma lem:convex-entropy-and-dudley, which needs precise published sources covering both displayed statements. The certified algorithm computes the empirical endpoint but does not make the confidence rule operational because its statistical correction uses an unspecified existence constant. The STAR section supplies a conditional identification audit after balanced subsampling rather than a native-count empirical tightening, limiting the package's applied evidence.
